scope: NATIVE_HELPER_VERSION_ONLY; no wrapper action/playbook/target SSH/default switch
argv:
set -eu
source "$1"
phase() {
  printf 'PHASE=%s\n' "$1"
  fds_engine_init
  for cli in ansible ansible-playbook ansible-inventory ansible-config; do
    printf 'CLI=%s\n' "$cli"
    fds_engine_exec "$cli" --version
  done
}
export FDS_ANSIBLE_ENGINE_DIR="$2/venv-2.21.3/bin"
export FDS_ANSIBLE_ENGINE_VERSION=2.21.3
phase candidate
export FDS_ANSIBLE_ENGINE_DIR="$2/venv-2.16.19/bin"
export FDS_ANSIBLE_ENGINE_VERSION=2.16.19
phase explicit-recovery
unset FDS_ANSIBLE_ENGINE_DIR FDS_ANSIBLE_ENGINE_VERSION
phase unset-fixed-path
